Momentary Switch (Pushbutton) - SPST
Normally-open (NO) SPST momentary switches (buttons, pushbuttons).
Variants PTH-12MM - 12mm square, through-hole
• https://www.sparkfun.com/products/9190 Momentary Pushbutton Switch - 12mm Square (COM-09190)
PTH-6.0MM, PTH-6.0MM-KIT - 6.0mm square, through-hole
• https://www.sparkfun.com/products/97 Mini Pushbutton Switch (COM-00097) • KIT package intended for soldering kit's - only one side of pads' copper is exposed.

• https://www.sparkfun.com/products/10791 Right Angle Tactile Button - Used on https://www.sparkfun.com/products/11734 SparkFun BigTime Watch Kit

• Used on https://www.sparkfun.com/products/13169 SparkFun Blackberry Trackballer Breakout

• Used on https://www.sparkfun.com/products/17717 SparkFun Pro Micro - RP2040
SMD-5.2MM, SMD-5.2-REDUNDANT - 5.2mm square, surface-mount
• https://www.sparkfun.com/products/8720 Mini Pushbutton Switch - SMD (COM-08720) • Used on https://www.sparkfun.com/products/11114 Arduino Pro Mini • REDUNDANT package connects both switch circuits together
